name: tKOIAgent
description: MCP server for automated transcriptomics analysis using tKOI (Transcriptomics Knowledge graph-driven Omics Integration) and SPOKE biomedical knowledge graph. Provides 13 specialized tools for environment setup, data processing, gene ID conversion, network analysis, visualization, and knowledge graph integration.

TKOI_LOGFC_THRESHOLD.title: Log Fold Change Threshold
TKOI_LOGFC_THRESHOLD.description: Minimum log fold-change threshold for identifying differentially expressed genes. Higher values (1.0-2.0) are more stringent, lower values (0.25-0.5) are more permissive. Typical range: 0.25-2.0

TKOI_INDIRECT_LINK_THRESHOLD.title: Indirect Link Threshold
TKOI_INDIRECT_LINK_THRESHOLD.description: Required indirect connectivity for downstream gene inclusion. Integer value representing minimum number of indirect connections. Higher values (3-5) are more stringent, lower values (1-2) are more permissive. Typical range: 1-5

TKOI_TOPOLOGY_SIMILARITY.title: Topology Similarity Threshold
TKOI_TOPOLOGY_SIMILARITY.description: Similarity threshold for selecting matched genes in permutations. Higher values (0.9-0.95) ensure very similar topology, lower values (0.7-0.85) allow more variation. Range: 0.0-1.0

TKOI_N_PERMUTATION.title: Number of Permutations
TKOI_N_PERMUTATION.description: Number of permutations for statistical significance testing. Higher values (1000-10000) provide more robust p-values but take longer, lower values (30-100) are faster but less precise. Minimum: 30

TKOI_DAMPING_FACTOR.title: Network Propagation Damping Factor
TKOI_DAMPING_FACTOR.description: Damping factor (alpha) for network propagation algorithm, controls restart probability. Higher values (0.9-0.95) allow information to propagate further through the network, lower values (0.7-0.8) keep information more localized. Typical range: 0.7-0.95

TKOI_MAXIMUM_ITERATION.title: Maximum Propagation Iterations
TKOI_MAXIMUM_ITERATION.description: Maximum iterations for network propagation convergence. Higher values (1000-5000) allow for more thorough convergence on complex networks, lower values (500-1000) are faster but may converge earlier. Minimum: 100

tools.name: tkoi_check_r_installation
tools.description: Verify R installation and version requirements. Checks if R is installed, accessible, and meets the minimum version requirement (R 4.0+). Returns R version, installation path, and status.

tools.name: tkoi_check_tkoi_installation
tools.description: Verify tKOI R package installation and availability. Checks if the tKOI package is installed and can be loaded. Returns installation status, version (if available), and any error messages.

tools.name: tkoi_install_tkoi_package
tools.description: Install the tKOI R package from GitHub. Automatically installs devtools if needed, then installs tKOI from the specified GitHub repository. Returns installation status and any error messages.

tools.name: tkoi_check_homebrew
tools.description: Check Homebrew installation status (macOS only). Verifies if Homebrew package manager is installed and provides installation instructions if missing. Useful for installing R and system dependencies.

tools.name: tkoi_validate_data_file
tools.description: Validate gene expression data file. Supports absolute (/path/to/file.csv) or home-relative (~/Desktop/ms_analysis/data.csv) paths. Tool resolves the path and validates file structure. All analysis outputs will be saved in the same directory as the input file. If valid=false, STOP workflow.

tools.name: tkoi_clean_data_file
tools.description: Clean and preprocess gene expression data. Supports absolute or home-relative (~/...) paths. Removes duplicate genes, filters zero-variance genes, handles missing values. Outputs saved to the same directory as input file.

tools.name: tkoi_convert_gene_ids
tools.description: Convert gene IDs to human Ensembl format using MyGene.info API. Supports absolute or home-relative (~/...) paths. Auto-detects input format (Symbol, Entrez, Ensembl, HGNC), converts to human Ensembl IDs, maps mouse genes to human orthologs. IMPORTANT: First checks if gene IDs are already in Ensembl format - if so, skips conversion and returns original file. Outputs saved to the same directory as input file.

tools.name: tkoi_run_analysis
tools.description: Execute tKOI network propagation analysis on gene expression data. IMPORTANT: May take 5-30 minutes depending on dataset size and n_permutation parameter - do not timeout. Supports absolute or home-relative (~/...) paths. Integrates SPOKE knowledge graph, performs network propagation using configurable parameters. All outputs (RDA and CSV formats) saved to the same directory as input file.

tools.name: tkoi_generate_plots
tools.description: Generate publication-quality visualizations from tKOI analysis results. Creates volcano plots, network diagrams, heatmaps, and pathway enrichment plots using ggplot2. Outputs high-resolution PNG images (800 dpi by default).

tools.name: tkoi_query_spoke_genes
tools.description: Query SPOKE knowledge graph for gene information and relationships. Retrieves gene properties, associated diseases, pathways, protein interactions, and chemical compounds. Returns structured data from the biomedical knowledge graph.

tools.name: tkoi_extract_spoke_subnetwork
tools.description: Extract and save a subnetwork from SPOKE centered on specified genes. Retrieves multi-hop neighborhoods including connected genes, proteins, diseases, and pathways. Exports subnetwork in multiple formats (GraphML, JSON, CSV) for visualization and analysis.

tools.name: tkoi_get_gene_disease_associations
tools.description: Retrieve gene-disease associations from SPOKE knowledge graph. For each gene, finds associated diseases with evidence types, confidence scores, and literature references. Useful for interpreting analysis results in disease context.

tools.name: tkoi_generate_analysis_report
tools.description: Generate comprehensive Markdown report summarizing tKOI analysis results. Includes methods description, statistical summaries, significant findings, visualizations, SPOKE integration results, file inventory, and citations. Outputs publication-ready README.md file.
